fields.description: Order Receive Date — the date the sales order was received; format as YYYY-MM-DD
Order No — the sales order number
Company Name — the customer company placing the order
Contact Person — the person to contact at the company
Contact No — the primary contact phone number; keep digits, +, - exactly as printed
Kind Attention — the addressee named in the 'Kind attention' / 'Kind attn' line
Contact No (second listing) — the alternate/second contact phone number on the order
Department — the department within the company
Delivery Address — the full address where the order is to be delivered
Expected Delivery Date — the expected delivery date; format as YYYY-MM-DD
Sales Person — the salesperson handling this order

items.description: Item Name — the name of the ordered item
Item Code (SKU) — the item code / SKU exactly as printed, including letters and hyphens
Pack Size — e.g. '500 ml', '1 kg', '6 x 250 ml'
Ordered Qty — the quantity ordered, as a whole number
Brand Name — the brand of the ordered item
